title: Threshing Day
author: Rebecca Yarros
summary: A short companion novella set in the world of Fourth Wing, where cadets at a brutal war college try to bond with dragons. It adds a small, self-contained story to an existing series.
readIf: you love the Empyrean series and want a quick extra visit to its dragon-riding world.
skipIf: you have not read Fourth Wing, because this is written for existing fans.

pairings.reason: The novel that introduced this dragon-rider war college and the characters the novella assumes you know.
An older, more earnest dragon-and-rider story with the same wonder at a bond between a person and a dragon.
Another school where students may not survive, with a cynical narrator and a rule-bound magic system.
